# intenter

Semantic runtime permission layer for AI coding agents

Intenter decides whether an AI coding agent may run a shell command,
based on what the command actually does rather than how it is spelled.

## Usage

```text
intenter
```

## Subcommands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`intenter approval`](intenter_approval.md) | Inspect and change one approval |
| [`intenter approvals`](intenter_approvals.md) | List what is trusted in this project |
| [`intenter approve`](intenter_approve.md) | Remember the effects of an evaluated command |
| [`intenter daemon`](intenter_daemon.md) | Run and manage the Intenter daemon |
| [`intenter doctor`](intenter_doctor.md) | Check the installation and suggest fixes |
| [`intenter history`](intenter_history.md) | Show what Intenter decided, and why |
| [`intenter hook`](intenter_hook.md) | Handle an agent hook invocation (called by the agent, not by you) |
| [`intenter setup`](intenter_setup.md) | Install the Intenter integration for an agent |
| [`intenter status`](intenter_status.md) | Show the daemon, integration and recent activity |
| [`intenter summary`](intenter_summary.md) | Count what Intenter decided, and how many prompts it answered for you |
| [`intenter uninstall`](intenter_uninstall.md) | Remove the Intenter integration for an agent |
| [`intenter update`](intenter_update.md) | Check for a new release and install it |
| [`intenter version`](intenter_version.md) | Print version, engine, protocol and schema versions |

## Options

| Flag | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| `--config` `<string>` | — | override the configuration file path |
| `--data-dir` `<string>` | — | override the Intenter data directory |
| `--json` | — | machine-readable JSON output |
| `-v`, `--verbose` | — | verbose output |
